scope: Complete deep review of the pinned repository’s root instructions/license, all project-local OpenCode agents, commands, skills, tool and TUI configuration, the linked operator documentation for agents/commands/skills/tools/MCP, and selected core configuration, skill, instruction, command, tool, and MCP loader/context files. Adjacent repository-specific support paths and unrelated customization files are indexed only.

limits: The recursive pinned tree contained 12,658 entries and was not truncated; general provider/business implementation and most tests were indexed only.

No active MCP server was configured. No project-local evaluation suite or OpenCode hook definition was found; the repo Git pre-push hook and core hook/context/memory implementation were indexed but not behavior-reviewed.

The custom GitHub PR tool was inspected but is disabled in project config; its registration/discovery path was not confirmed, so it is recorded as an inactive, unknown-compatibility example rather than an adoptable component.
Source-tree review did not execute, clone, install, or enable any source content.
